tool.name: OpenSwathInfer
tool.command:
@QUOTE_FOO@ @EXT_FOO@ #import re
## Preprocessing mkdir in && cp '$in' 'in/${re.sub("[^\w\-_]", "_", $in.element_identifier)}.$gxy2omsext($in.ext)' && #if "out_FLAG" in str($OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS).split(',') mkdir out && #end if
## Main program call
set -o pipefail && @EXECUTABLE@ -write_ctd ./ && python3 '$__tool_directory__/fill_ctd.py' '@EXECUTABLE@.ctd' '$args_json' '$hardcoded_json' && @EXECUTABLE@ -ini @EXECUTABLE@.ctd -in 'in/${re.sub("[^\w\-_]", "_", $in.element_identifier)}.$gxy2omsext($in.ext)' #if "out_FLAG" in str($OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS).split(',') -out 'out/output.${gxy2omsext("osw")}' #end if #if len(str($OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS).split(',')) == 0 | tee '$stdout' #end if
## Postprocessing #if "out_FLAG" in str($OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS).split(',') && mv 'out/output.${gxy2omsext("osw")}' '$out' #end if #if "ctd_out_FLAG" in $OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS && mv '@EXECUTABLE@.ctd' '$ctd_out' #end if

param.label: Input OpenSWATH OSW file

param.name: run
param.label: Enable peptidoform inference in this invocation

param.name: ipf_ms1_scoring
param.label: Use MS1 precursor evidence

param.name: ipf_ms2_scoring
param.label: Use MS2 precursor evidence from transition-level precursor rows

param.name: ipf_h0
param.label: Include the null hypothesis in IPF transition inference

param.name: ipf_grouped_fdr
param.label: Compute model FDR separately per num_peptidoforms group

param.name: ipf_max_peakgroup_pep
param.label: Maximum peakgroup PEP for entering precursor inference

param.name: ipf_max_precursor_pep
param.label: Maximum precursor-level evidence PEP for precursor inference

param.name: ipf_max_precursor_peakgroup_pep
param.label: Maximum precursor-peakgroup PEP retained for transition inference

param.name: ipf_max_transition_pep
param.label: Maximum transition evidence PEP retained for IPF

param.name: propagate_signal_across_runs
param.label: Propagate confident transition evidence across aligned runs using FEATURE_MS2_ALIGNMENT_CANDIDATE

param.name: ipf_min_alignment_mapping_confidence
param.label: Minimum mapping confidence retained for across-run propagation from FEATURE_MS2_ALIGNMENT_CANDIDATE

param.name: across_run_confidence_threshold
param.label: Maximum transition PEP eligible for across-run propagation

param.name: global
param.label: Enable peptide inference in the global context

param.name: experiment_wide
param.label: Enable peptide inference in the experiment-wide context

param.name: run_specific
param.label: Enable peptide inference in the run-specific context

param.name: global
param.label: Enable protein inference in the global context

param.name: experiment_wide
param.label: Enable protein inference in the experiment-wide context

param.name: run_specific
param.label: Enable protein inference in the run-specific context

param.name: global
param.label: Enable gene inference in the global context

param.name: experiment_wide
param.label: Enable gene inference in the experiment-wide context

param.name: run_specific
param.label: Enable gene inference in the run-specific context

param.name: parametric
param.label: Use parametric p-value estimation instead of empirical estimation

param.name: pfdr
param.label: Use positive FDR in q-value and s-value calculations

param.name: pi0_lambda
param.label: Lambda grid for pi0 estimation
param.help: (space separated list, in order to allow for spaces in list items surround them by single quotes)

param.name: pi0_method
param.label: Method for pi0 estimation

param.name: pi0_smooth_df
param.label: Degrees of freedom for smoother-based pi0 estimation

param.name: pi0_smooth_log_pi0
param.label: Smooth log(pi0) instead of pi0 directly

param.name: lfdr_truncate
param.label: Truncate local FDR/PEP values to [0,1]

param.name: lfdr_monotone
param.label: Enforce monotone local FDR/PEP estimates

param.name: lfdr_transformation
param.label: Transformation used by local FDR estimation

param.name: lfdr_adj
param.label: Adjustment factor for local FDR estimation bandwidth

param.name: lfdr_eps
param.label: Epsilon used to clip p-values before local FDR estimation
Overrides tool-specific checks
Enables the test mode (needed for internal use only)

param.name: OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS
param.label: Optional outputs

data.name: out
data.label: ${tool.name} on ${on_string}: out
data.filter: OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS is not None and "out_FLAG" in OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS

data.name: ctd_out
data.label: ${tool.name} on ${on_string}: ctd
data.filter: OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS is not None and "ctd_out_FLAG" in OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS

tool.help:
Runs inference on OpenSWATH results.
For more information, visit https://www.openms.de/doxygen/release/3.6.0/html/TOPP_OpenSwathInfer.html
